files.tests/check_config.py:
from pathlib import Path
import re
import tomllib

text = Path('config/matcher.toml').read_bytes().decode('utf-8').replace('\r\n', '\n')
assert re.fullmatch('\\[suggestions\\]\\nn = [^\\s#]+\\ncutoff = [^\\s#]+\\n?', text), 'Only the requested value tokens may change'
cfg = tomllib.loads(text)
v = cfg['suggestions']
assert type(v['n']) is int and v['n'] == 5
assert type(v['cutoff']) in (int, float) and v['cutoff'] == 0.6
